newsitem.title: UK: UK's Waste sells French operations to Sita.
newsitem.headline: UK's Waste sells French operations to Sita.

text.p: Britain's Waste Management International Plc said on Monday it had sold its remaining operations in France to Sita, a unit of Lyonnaise des Eaux, for about 28 million stg in cash.
Waste will also receive 5.7 million stg within the next three years from Sita and 33.8 million in promissary notes.
It said in a statement that the disposale consists of its unit Waste Management France Holding and around 33.8 million stg of intercompany debt.
Waste said it will retain a 50 percent stake in Auxiwaste Services, a company that operates a brinitm materials recovery and fibre fuel plant in central France.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to reduce debt and for general corporate purposes.
